paragraphs.text: Uncle Istvan was a man from the Eln Forest on Terisiare during the Dark Age of Dominaria .

Istvan was an old hermit, living alone in the Eln Forest. Eventually, the solitude drove him insane, and he became murderous to any intruders. Wielding a bloodied axe, his only company was those he could catch.
Uncle Istvan gained enough notoriety that curses used in later parts of the Dark Age included "Uncle Istvan-damned", "Uncle Istvan take it all", and "Uncle Istvan piss on it".
When first printed in The Dark , Uncle Istvan had the unique Creature type of Uncle Istvan . This was given errata in the Grand Creature Type Update to be Human .
